content:
Maria Liu: Heads up — EnterpriseX returned the SIG/CAIQ with a blocker: they require logs for inference requests to be retained 365d and encrypted with customer-managed keys. They flagged 'encryption-at-rest' as a hard requirement for Dedicated hosting. Link: https://redwood.internal/share/entX-sig-answers

Kevin Shah: Can you paste the exact exception text from the questionnaire? need to see scope (model logs vs full request payloads).

Maria Liu: Here are the parts they highlighted:
```
Q: Do you encrypt logs at rest?
A: Redwood: yes (platform-managed keys)
Customer: requires KMS with customer-held key AND 365d retention for inference logs (including prompts)
Requested: exception/compensating-controls to allow Hosted Dedicated to continue storing logs for debugging/quality during POC.
```

DevSecBot: Auto-scan: flagged potential PII risk in retained prompts (high), recommends redaction + strict access controls. See rule IDs: DS-PII-03, LOG-RET-12.

Kevin Shah: Ok — high-level: we can do a POC-level acceptance with compensating controls, but we need: 1) CMK (customer KMS) for encrypting logs, 2) explicit field-level redaction for PII before log persist, 3) limited ACLs + IAM audit, 4) SIEM export to customer's account within 48h, 5) retention TTL enforced via lifecycle policy and 90d review.

Ethan Park: Infrastructure note: Dedicated nodes can be configured to use an external KMS for EBS/S3 encryption and we can wire log-forwarding to a customer S3 in their account. Redaction would be done in the proxy layer — requires a quick config change. ETA: we can stand this up for a POC in ~3 business days.

Priya Menon: Sales: we need this answered before EOW — AE is pushing for a signed LOI. If security can approve a conditional exception for POC, we can keep momentum. Is the CMK requirement blocking?

Kevin Shah: CMK is a blocker only if the customer insists on holding private key material inside their HSM with no access by Redwood. For a POC we can accept CMK with cross-account key policy (customer retains control) + attested rotation policy. Production (full Dedicated/Private) will require CISO sign-off and legal addendum.

Maria Liu: Proposed compensating controls to present to EnterpriseX (draft):
```
1) Use customer-managed KMS (cross-account CMK) for all log buckets.
2) Apply field-level redaction for detected PII (names, SSNs, cards) before writing logs.
3) Strict RBAC: only named engineers with justification can access logs; access requires mfa + approval ticket.
4) Real-time export: mirror logs to customer-owned S3 within 48h; Redwood retains a 7d buffer for incident debugging.
5) Retention policy: 365d in customer S3; Redwood retention reduced to 7d for POC.
6) Quarterly attestation & 90-day risk review by Security.
```

Kevin Shah: I want small tweaks: change item 5 to "365d in customer-owned storage; Redwood retains at most 7d copies for POC and deletes afterward". Add requirement: customer signs Acknowledgement of residual logs used for debugging during POC.

Ethan Park: Confirmed — can implement cross-account S3 replication and lifecycle to enforce deletion. We can also enable server-side encryption with CMK and write IAM condition to reject writes without the CMK header.

DevSecBot: Checklist update: once CMK + redaction enabled, risk drops from high->medium for PII retention. Submit ticket SEC-4983 for CISO review.

Priya Menon: If Security signs off for POC with those controls, AE will get the LOI signed today. Any objections?

Kevin Shah: I'm ok providing conditional approval for POC only. Requirements before approval: 1) Implementation ticket and runbook in infra, 2) Customer acknowledgement doc, 3) CISO notified and asked for fast-track review. After those, I will mark as approved in the risk register for POC scope only.

Maria Liu: I'll own the runbook + customer acknowledgement. I'll create PRD + runbook and ping CISO. ETA: docs + ticket by EOD today.

Kevin Shah: Fine. Tagging next step: @CISO (not in thread) — please review SEC-4983 when pinged. For the Slack thread: conditional POC approval granted pending the three items Kevin listed.

Maria Liu: Thanks — I'll post updates here as I create the ticket and the customer acknowledgement. Priya, please hold sales for final sign-off until I confirm implementation ticket. :thumbsup:

Priya Menon: Got it, holding. Thanks team!
